title: Midnight Velocity
styleReference: Cinematic realism in three.js after night-city references (Shinjuku, Hong Kong, highway light trails): an original widebody supercar, a rain-wet neon city, planar reflections on the road, bloom, camera motion blur that keeps the car sharp, light trails. No text on signs, no logos.

scenes.title: The Reveal
scenes.logline: A widebody supercar waits on a rain-soaked neon street; the camera slides from its headlight along the wheel and bodywork to a low front three-quarter; the engine starts, the lights flare, it revs.
scenes.props: supercar; underglow; rain; steam vents; billboards; palm trees; wet asphalt

scenes.title: The Launch
scenes.logline: It launches: the rear tyre spins and throws water, flames on the gear change; a low front tracking shot as it races at the lens, then a side mount as the city blurs.
scenes.props: wheel spin; spray; exhaust flames; suspension squat

scenes.title: Neon Boulevard
scenes.logline: Full speed down a broad neon boulevard past traffic, palms and billboards: ultra-low front, side profile, rear chase, an overhead drone, and the driver's hands on the wheel as he shifts.
scenes.props: traffic; billboards; palms; street lamps; cockpit; dashboard lights

scenes.title: The Tunnel
scenes.logline: Into a long tunnel of cyan, purple and white LED strips; behind, then alongside, then a hood view as it curves; out into the city's light.
scenes.props: LED strips; tunnel walls; hood camera; exit flare

scenes.title: The Drift
scenes.logline: At a closed-off city intersection it brakes, swings the tail out and drifts the corner on countersteer through smoke and mist, then grips and launches.
scenes.props: drift; tyre smoke; mist; headlight sweep; closed course

scenes.title: Elevated Highway
scenes.logline: Up onto an elevated highway between glowing towers; bumper cam, then a rising aerial sweep along a broad curve through ribbons of red and white light, under a skybridge.
scenes.props: elevated highway; light trails; skybridge; gantries; towers

scenes.title: The Overlook
scenes.logline: It sweeps onto a skyline overlook and stops under the city lights, idling; water drips; the camera pulls back from the front wheel to the car against the endless city.
